fusions.name: Quill Overboard
fusions.desc: Drops a quill from overhead onto the first enemy in its path. It deals 4 damage, and its reach is 40% longer.

fusions.name: Stoop From Height
fusions.desc: Carries you down onto a target up to 8 tiles away. The stoop deals 28 damage, rising to 2 times that at maximum range, and it is always a critical hit.

fusions.name: Updraft Hop
fusions.desc: Lifts you over the ground and sets you down at a point up to 8 tiles away. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds after.

fusions.name: Coasting Glide
fusions.desc: When your stamina runs out, you regain 15 stamina. Once every 45 seconds.
